title: Nk'Mip Desert Cultural Centre

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Group rates are available for guided tours, with admission fees are payable by the group leader on the day of the visit. We can tailor the tour to fit your schedule and the interests of your group. While most guided tours last 1.5 hours, shorter options are also available. School groups begin their tour with the 20 minute feature film, "Coyote Spirit" which depicts a young girls encounter with the spirit of Coyote on her visit to the Osoyoos Indian Reserve.
